text:
sylvia: Quick onboarding snag: the Next starter that demos streaming + function calls is dropping chunks in the browser and the eval harness flags non-deterministic outputs. Anyone else see streaming truncation?
tobias: Yep. Repro: yarn dev, open the demo chat, ask a question that triggers function/tool call. The UI shows partial response then hangs. Network shows SSE stream closed with 200 but missing final chunk.
harry: I traced it to the serverless handler using `res.end()` prematurely in the example. The streaming helper in the starter wraps the SDK stream but calls `res.end()` immediately after wiring, which can close the underlying connection before final flush.
maya: Also saw a parity issue: the sample uses `client.stream({ onDelta })` callback shape that differed from sdk-js v1.0 signature in our docs. Starter uses old callback order `onChunk, onDone` which causes the UI plumbing to ignore the last call.
sylvia: Another thing: the Dockerfile in the examples/next-starter misses an env declaration for RW_ALLOW_INSECURE_LOCALHOST, so when folks try Dockerized quickstart for Private testing they get CORS/auth errors and blame our platform.
tobias: Proposed fixes: (1) update starter to use the canonical stream helper from sdk-js v1.0: `for await (const chunk of client.stream(...)) {}` instead of callbacks; (2) remove premature res.end() and flush/close only after stream finishes; (3) add a note + default ENV in Dockerfile.
harry: I'll open a small PR to change the streaming pattern and add an integration test in the eval harness that asserts the last token arrives and final event logged.
maya: I'll take the Dockerfile/readme change. Add `ENV RW_ALLOW_INSECURE_LOCALHOST=1` as an example and document security implications. Also update quickstart docs to show Docker run with port mapping and env.
tobias: For parity, add a tiny compatibility shim in the starter `lib/compat-stream.ts` so older users running earlier SDK still get the demo working, but mark it deprecated.
ci-bot: created issue DE-812: "next-starter: streaming truncation + function-call callback parity + docker env missing" assigned to @harry @maya @tobias.
sylvia: Workaround for devs: use polling mode (non-stream) in the demo by toggling `STREAM=false` in .env until PR lands. Also include a tiny snippet in README to check `curl -N` SSE endpoint to inspect chunks.
harry: PR #401 opened: switch to async iterator stream + test that waits for final token and asserts telemetry.event 'stream.complete'.
maya: PR #402 opened: Dockerfile and README updates, plus a small note about Private deployment envs.
tobias: I'll draft the compat shim PR and a short blurb in the release notes about the streaming API change.
ci-bot: linked DE-812 to onboarding board and labeled needs-e2e.
sylvia: thanks team. Once merged, we should update the starter used by the get-started flow so new users don't hit this subtle streaming + docker pain.
